items.difficulty_reason: This is the master criterion all fpqc descent lemmas in the chapter feed on. The proof assembles the descent from three assumptions: base-change stability from (2), a reduction to affine test schemes via (2), refinement of the fpqc covering by a standard fpqc covering of affine schemes mapping into the $Y_{i_j}$, a coproduct assembly using (1), and the final application of (3) to the resulting surjective flat morphism of affine schemes.
